title: Your Vision Foundation Model Is Secretly an EEG Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.17031v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are pretrained on thousands of hours of recordings, yet their frozen features transfer poorly to downstream tasks, and this transfer does not consistently improve with larger models or more pretraining data. We show that a vision foundation model that has never seen EEG is a stronger frozen EEG encoder than these specialized models, once the signals are rendered as images that a vision transformer can read. Our method, SeeEEG, keeps the vision backbone frozen and learns only how EEG is displayed to it. Each channel occupies a dedicated row of patches and is drawn either as a waveform at a fixed gain or as a scalogram whose frequency range spans the patch height, so that task-relevant patterns fall within individual tokens. translated_title: 你的视觉基础模型其实就是一个脑电图（EEG）基础模型
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型通常在数千小时的记录数据上进行预训练，然而其冻结特征向下游任务的迁移效果不佳，且这种迁移性能并不能随着模型规模增大或预训练数据增多而持续提升。我们证明，一个从未见过EEG数据的视觉基础模型，一旦将信号渲染为视觉Transformer可读取的图像形式，就能成为比这些专门的EEG模型更强的冻结EEG编码器。我们的方法SeeEEG保持视觉骨干网络完全冻结，仅学习EEG信号如何呈现给它。每个通道占据一行专用的patch（图像块），并以固定增益的波形或频率范围覆盖整个patch高度的小波尺度图形式绘制，使得与任务相关的模式落在单个token内。这种显示方式的导联组合、滤波和对比度参数由标准临床导联组合初始化，并通过冻结的骨干网络利用任务损失进行优化。
tldr: 将脑电信号渲染为图像后，一个从未见过EEG数据的视觉基础模型可以作为比专门的EEG基础模型更强的冻结EEG编码器，且仅需学习信号的呈现方式而无需微调骨干网络。
en_tdlr: Once EEG signals are rendered as images, a vision foundation model that has never seen EEG serves as a stronger frozen EEG encoder than specialized EEG foundation models, requiring only optimization of the signal display while keeping the vision backbone frozen.
